comparison.objective: Candidate removes sacrificial tangs from installed inserts; record assembles and secures a gel-casting cassette.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests coaxial impact tooling and loose-fragment recovery; record tests glass-plate alignment, pressure-cam closure, assembly transfer, spring-clip release, and stable insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, four tangs in a tray, retained inserts, and no damage; record requires secured aligned plates, cassette seated in its stand, clip released, and stable gripper withdrawal. Specs are absent.
comparison.reason: Cassette clamping and transfer have no fracture or fragment-recovery outcome despite both requiring alignment and force care.
